newsitem.title: UK: Recovery could go on for many years - UK"s Clarke.
newsitem.headline: Recovery could go on for many years - UK"s Clarke.

text.p: Britain's economic recovery could continue for many years to come provided the government pursues prudent policies, Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Tuesday.
In an interview with BBC radio, Clarke said: "I think this recovery could go on for many years more if we combine it with low inflation and so long as we keep public finances in control."
